create.name: John Holland
create.bio:
John Holland is an American psychic medium, author and teacher of mediumship who works mostly across New England and online. He says he grew up sensing he was different, and that a serious car accident at about thirty brought his psychic abilities fully to the surface. Wanting to understand how mediumship actually works, he spent two years studying in Britain with experienced mediums and Spiritualist organisations before beginning to give private sittings and then public demonstrations in the United States, Canada, Australia and the UK.

His teaching focuses on the practical mechanics of making contact with the spirit world and on developing intuition in an ethical, grounded way. He runs in-person workshops, currently in Massachusetts and New Hampshire, holds messages-from-spirit evenings, and sells recorded webinars on clairvoyance, auras, synchronicity and mediumship, several taught with fellow mediums such as Janet Nohavec. He founded the online My Soul Community, and has written six books, including Bridging Two Realms for Hay House, as well as oracle decks such as The Spirit Messages Daily Guidance cards and The Mediumship Training Deck. His style is warm and plain-spoken, with humour.

courses.title: The Psychic Foundation: Weekend Workshop
courses.description: A two-day in-person workshop in Methuen, Massachusetts, on finding and strengthening your own psychic senses through meditation, visualisation and practical exercises. It also looks at how psychic awareness differs from contact with spirit; a certificate of completion is given.

courses.title: Spirit of the Season 2026
courses.description: An afternoon event at Aura Wellness in Merrimack, New Hampshire, where John gives messages from spirit to as many of the audience as time allows, in a seasonal setting. A reading for each guest is not guaranteed.

courses.title: Bridging Two Realms webinar
courses.description: A two-hour recorded webinar on how loved ones who have died may make contact and how to recognise and respond to it. Rented as streaming video.

courses.title: Aspects of Mediumship: The Full Series, Parts 1-6
courses.description: A six-part recorded series with Janet Nohavec for mediumship students at every level, from beginners to working mediums. It covers unfolding these abilities safely and responsibly.

courses.title: Enhancing Your Psychic Abilities: The Full Series
courses.description: Four recorded classes with Janet Nohavec on developing psychic perception, offered as streaming video on demand.

courses.title: Third Eye Awakening: Learn To Develop And Harness The Power of Your Clairvoyance
courses.description: A recorded webinar with Pam Coronado on uses and techniques of clairvoyance drawn from both teachers' long practice.

courses.title: Aura: The Human Psychic Atmosphere
courses.description: A two-hour recorded webinar on understanding and working with the energy field around each person.

courses.title: Magic of the Soul
courses.description: A one-hour recorded webinar on synchronicity as one of the main ways the soul shows itself, and how to notice and act on it.

courses.title: Dream Work: Unlocking The Power of Dream Interpretation
courses.description: A two-and-a-half-hour recorded webinar with Kevin Todeschi on understanding dreams, mixing teaching with practical examples.

free_resources.title: Daily Oracle Card Reading
free_resources.description: A free online card draw on his site using his oracle decks. You settle, ask one clear question and pick a single card for guidance, once a day.
